;;; case E9_bangPrefix_t02

fn ! solve n: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(a (+ n 2))
        (b (* n 2))
        (ws [a b (+ a b)])
        (opt (cond (> b 0) (some b) (else none)))
        (result (mt opt ((some v) (+ (listSum ws) 1)) (none (listSum ws))))]
    (let [(printed (println result))]
      result)))

;;; case E9_bangSuffix_t02
(module cand :x [solve])

fn solve! n: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(a (+ n 2))
        (b (* n 2))
        (ws [a b (+ a b)])
        (opt (cond ((> b 0) (some b)) (else none)))
        (result (cond ((some? opt) (+ (listSum ws) 1)) (else (listSum ws))))
        (printed (println result))]
     result)
